title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued a critical security advisory for multiple vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel packages included in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4. The update addresses several security flaws including out-of-bounds reads, improper ownership management, and validation issues across various kernel subsystems such as networking, HID, Bluetooth, SCTP, ARM64, SCSI, NVMe, and IPv4. The advisory also includes bug fixes and enhancements to prevent kernel panics and NULL-pointer dereferences. Systems must be rebooted after applying the update to ensure the fixes take effect.
